Settings.PromptOwner: Guardian's player (GM when no player is online)

interceptEnabled.Name: Intercept Attack prompts
interceptEnabled.Hint: When an ally near a guardian takes physical damage (or energy damage with Energy Interceptor), ask the guardian whether to Intercept Attack and redirect the damage.

interceptPromptTarget.Name: Who answers Intercept prompts
interceptPromptTarget.Hint: Choose whether the guardian's player or the GM decides interceptions.

interceptTimeout.Name: Intercept prompt timeout (seconds)
interceptTimeout.Hint: An unanswered prompt counts as declining, and the ally takes the damage.

interceptScope.Name: Damage the guardian takes
interceptScope.Hint: Intercept Attack triggers on physical damage. Choose whether the guardian takes only those damage types (the ally keeps the rest) or the whole roll.

interceptAutoMove.Name: Step into place automatically
interceptAutoMove.Hint: Move the guardian to the nearest open square adjacent to the ally on square grids. Guardians can still choose to move themselves.

tauntEnabled.Name: Taunt automation
tauntEnabled.Hint: Apply PF2e's Effect: Taunt to targeted enemies when a guardian uses Taunt, enforcing range, Group Taunt limits, and one taunt at a time.

tauntOffGuard.Name: Taunt off-guard
tauntOffGuard.Hint: Make a taunted enemy off-guard when it attacks one of the guardian's allies instead of the guardian, and remind the GM when it casts spells.

trackReactions.Name: Track guardian reactions
trackReactions.Hint: Track each guardian's reactions in combat, including Ever Ready's reaction at initiative and Reaction Time's extra guardian-only reaction, and show them in the combat tracker.
